notes: The sheet is a typescript with handwritten corrections and a long cancellation stroke across the page. I have not attributed the correcting hand. H treats it as a reused topos draft; the visible text itself is transcribed in full here.
The own page number has a doubtful first digit, read 7|2, then definite 2. The inverted archive 27 is retained only as a comment. There is no date, title, or total page count on the sheet.

The opening continuation discusses a morphism of toposes and uniqueness up to unique isomorphism in terms of the given image functors. Section 3.1.2 then states that direct image commutes with projective limits and inverse image with inductive limits and finite projective limits, hence is exact.

The body describes species of algebraic structure using arrows, base sets, finite projective limits, and arbitrary inductive limits. It lists group, ring, module, comodule, bialgebra, and torsor examples, retaining the local deletion of ou de bimodule.

The source explicitly declines a formal treatment: “Plutôt que d'entrer dans la tâche peu engageante de donner un sens précis à cet énoncé et de le justifier de façon formelle”. The inserted “l'expliciter et de” strengthens the advice to the reader to work out and convince themselves of the examples; it is not a proof supplied here.

The cancelled footnote words On peut and vérifier que are not a surviving instruction to verify. A raised (1.5 et 1.8) replaces the latter phrase. The last sentence beginning D'ailleurs is also locally cancelled, in addition to the page-wide strike.

The literal singulars “est muni” and “telles que celle de” remain unchanged. The tight boundaries “).Comme” and “,pour” remain unspaced. The cut-edge “se définis” and absence of a visible closing parenthesis after “droite” are not completed.

The half images settled ordinary arrow direction, star height, the underlined object E, and ordinary underlined typed U. The local E retouch was not promoted to a definite double-struck alphabet; no mathematical expectation was used to complete it.

The three explicit x marks in blank cells are cancellation impressions, not proposed underlying letters. The definite star and Sigma remain outside the doubts concerning their additional point and faint arc.

H is mostly an editorial summary on this sheet. Its omitted prose blocks, omitted cancellation states, missing graphics, and the specific wrong replacement description, qui placement, and script-U claim are distinguished in the differences list.

math_checks.check: Domain/codomain and adjunction-direction consistency check actually performed
math_checks.result: Each displayed u_* points from E to E', while u^* points from E' to E. Reading u^* as the left adjoint and u_* as its right adjoint makes the text's assignment of inductive limits to u^* and projective limits to u_* directionally consistent.
math_checks.scope: This was a type/variance check only. I did not prove the adjoint-existence criterion in the footnote or verify the general species-of-structure assertion.
